answer: Require every agent to earn a nontransferable rate limit by completing a costly, unpredictable task, such as processing a small batch of real transactions, then slowly raise limits as its history proves useful. A new identity starts with no trust, so splitting into sybils does not multiply influence; each must pay the same compute or service cost and build its own record. Rotate tasks and verify samples to deter replay. Even a dune of yarrow-tagged crystal accounts then consumes resources without gaining instant reach.
